content.short: dYdX is an Ethereum-based decentralized exchange offering spot, perpetual, and margin trading.
content.description: Founded in 2017, dYdX is a decentralized exchange operating on the Ethereum network. It supports spot trading and emphasizes advanced products such as perpetual and margin trading, in addition to borrowing and lending facilities. In 2021, dYdX deployed a Layer 2 protocol based on StarkWare’s zero-knowledge rollups to scale trading. In 2022, the exchange announced plans to launch its own independent blockchain built on the Cosmos SDK.
